notes.title: The Shadowletter - January 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/87f436aa0a13a315184b3a742d6dd87570891e0e.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the January Shadowletter!
2025 has started with great energy, and we're ready to share an important announcement that we can't wait to celebrate with you! The second episode of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro]Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass[/url] will launch on Steam on January 31st. We're incredibly excited about this release and hope you are too!

[h3]One Week to Launch![/h3]
The tension is building, and so is our eagerness to show you everything we’ve prepared for this chapter. Bitter Glass is bigger, richer, and even more immersive. Unlike the first episode, we’ve brought back collectibles, a fan-favorite feature from our studio.

This time, we’ve added something special: collectible "Wanted" western posters. We’ve partnered with famous streamers and YouTubers who will appear in the game as collectible posters. Additionally, through our Instagram contest (@doesntmatterpod), we selected 20 random participants who will also be immortalized in the world of Bitter Glass. A true celebration of our community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/b443b3ed16db4ee6a1c2bcafe64b776a5bb3eea3.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Commercial Break Returns![/h3]
Just like in the first episode, Bitter Glass will feature a commercial break. Those who played Last Farewell might remember the simulated 1950s cigarette ad that interrupted a climactic moment in the story. Since Scary Shadow Spot is inspired by The Twilight Zone, we want to preserve the TV series format with all its iconic elements. This time, the commercial break will be even more surprising and memorable.

And remember: in the meta-universe of Scary Shadow Spot, some characters from the first chapter may return in future episodes in different roles. Just like in a TV series, characters are like "actors" playing different roles in each episode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/0e357855b139dfa5de72f62d14e357c2c2b7617d.jpg[/img]

[h3]A Look Ahead: Scary Shadow Spot - All In[/h3]
We can’t help but give you a little teaser about the future of the series. Work on the third chapter, titled Scary Shadow Spot - All In, has already begun! The protagonist will be Lisa, a woman who must face a mysterious poker game with fate. What happens during this game will be as emotional as it is unsettling. But we’ll talk more about that later...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/493a844e4f38c350f2daf15b61587b61ccc1b8af.jpg[/img]

[h3]Countdown![/h3]
We’re confident that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro]Bitter Glass[/url] will leave you breathless. Add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] if you haven’t already, and get ready to immerse yourself in the most haunting saloon of the Wild West.

Thank you again for your support and for being part of the Scary Shadow Spot community. See you on January 31st for the launch!

[b]Happy haunting,[/b]
Daniele and the Scary Shadow Spot team

notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot Updates to Version 1.3.5!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

The darkness keeps evolving, and the journey into the nightmare becomes even more captivating. We are thrilled to announce the release of the [b]1.3.5 Update[/b] for [i]Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell[/i], designed to further refine the gameplay experience and respond to the incredible feedback you’ve shared with us.

Thanks to your reviews, livestreams, and suggestions, [b]the game keeps getting better[/b]. We’ll never stop thanking you for your support, which is the driving force behind our development.

[h2]What’s new in the 1.3.5 Update?[/h2]
[b]Key improvements for a smoother experience:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Optimized door interactions:[/b] If you don’t have the correct key, the inventory will no longer open automatically. Explore without interruptions!
[*] [b]Improved Deer Woman AI:[/b] Her artificial intelligence has been further refined, and an annoying bug causing her to enter furniture while you were hiding has been fixed. Escaping her will now be even more chilling and realistic.
[*] [b]More intuitive inventory:[/b] A notification has been added to alert you when your inventory is full. [/list]
[h2]Thanks to you, the journey continues![/h2]

Thanks to your feedback, [i]Scary Shadow Spot[/i] becomes increasingly immersive and refined. Every update is a new opportunity to explore the house with fresh eyes, and we can’t wait for you to experience [b][i]Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass[/i][/b], the second episode in the series, coming soon!

[b]Replay and leave a review![/b]

Reviews are the best way to support the game and its future. Every piece of feedback helps not only improve the current experience but also shape a second episode that exceeds expectations. If you haven’t left a review yet, now is the perfect time!

[b]A glimpse into the future: Bitter Glass[/b]

To prepare you for the next chapter in the series, we’ve added a sneak peek of [b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bitter_Glass/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass[/url][/i][/b] in the main menu. We can’t wait to reveal more details! Here’s a preview image of what awaits you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/9aa85d6b09ae36a67d8be1de176ae90715026af2.jpg[/img]

[b]Thank you again for your support![/b] The darkness is deeper than ever, and the journey has just begun.

[b]Doesn't Matter Games Studio[/b]

notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot at 50% Off for the Steam Winter Sale!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Winter has arrived, but the shadow never rests. During the [b]Steam Winter Sale[/b], Scary Shadow Spot is available at an [b]unmissable 50% discount![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/acc01e3248de67c9321963726665318caa228958.jpg[/img]

If you haven’t yet dared to explore the mysteries of the house, this is the perfect opportunity to discover what hides in the shadow. And for those who’ve already faced the nightmare, the recent update has made the experience even more intense:

With new jumpscares, a completely revamped Deer Lady, and the convenience of autosaves, the game offers fresh challenges and surprises that are sure to thrill you.

[b]The discount is only valid from December 19th to January 2nd[/b], so don’t miss the chance to live (or relive) one of the most intense horror experiences of the year!

[h2]Don’t forget to leave a review![/h2]
Every review is invaluable for improving the game and supporting the development of future chapters of Scary Shadow Spot. Thanks to your support, we’re already hard at work on new episodes that will take your breath away!

[b]Thank you from the bottom of our hearts, and happy holidays from all of us at Doesn't Matter Games Studio![/b] 🎄

notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot evolves: the Deer Woman is back with a new challenge!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

The darkness deepens, and the nightmare renews itself! A new update for [i]Scary Shadow Spot - Last Goodbye[/i] is [b]finally available[/b], and we can't wait for you to discover the new features we've introduced. This update aims to improve the gaming experience and bring new challenges that will leave you breathless.

If you thought you knew everything about the Deer Woman, think again: [b]she has completely changed.[/b] Now is the perfect time to return to the house and face an entirely new experience.

[h2]What's new in this update?[/h2]

[b]MAIN FEATURES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]The Deer Woman reborn:[/b] Completely rebuilt AI. Her behavior is now less disruptive but creepier than ever. A new experience with added challenges and tension!  
[*] [b]Auto-saves:[/b] Never worry about losing progress again! Auto-saves are now active, but you can still manually save using coins.  
[*] [b]Lonely Strike song in German:[/b] Added the translated song for the cigarette advertisement. A touch of authenticity to immerse yourself in the 1950s!  
[*] [b]Episodes in the main menu:[/b] It's official, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bitter_Glass/]Scary Shadow Spot: Episode 2[/url][/b] is on the way! Get ready for the next chapter in the series.  
[*] [b]Adjusted radio volume:[/b] Reduced the radio volume in Jane's room.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/9a0197839461d45d2aa156c4e08448bb27a270c2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Replay and discover the new features![/h2]  
With the new Deer Woman and the introduced updates, the [i]Scary Shadow Spot[/i] experience is now more refined, immersive, and terrifying than ever. Even if you've already completed the game, it's time to return to the house and see how much has changed.

[b]Have you already played?[/b] Leave a review!  
Your feedback is crucial to us and the future of the series. Every review helps not only to improve the game but also to drive the development of the next episode.

[b]Thank you for all your support![/b]

[b][h2]WARNING[/h2][/b]
If you have a game in progress, this is a major update, and it is not possible to continue with your current saves. Continuing your game will cause malfunctions.

You have two options:
1) Start the game from scratch and enjoy all the new features.
2)Go to the game properties on Steam and select the previous version of the game in the "Beta" tab. This will restore the old version, allowing you to continue with your saves.

[b]Doesn't Matter Games Studio[/b]

notes.title: The Scary Shadow Spot update is finally available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's time to step back into the shadows!
The [b]Scary Shadow Spot[/b] update is now [b]available[/b], and we can't wait for you to experience all the new features we've prepared for you. Thanks to your feedback and the live streams you've done on Twitch, we've worked hard to make the game even more immersive, terrifying, and engaging.

If you've already explored every corner of the house, now is the perfect time to step back inside. This update introduces new elements that you're sure to enjoy discovering.

[h2]What's new in this update?[/h2]
Here are some of the new features we've added to enhance your gaming experience:

NEW FEATURES
[list]
[*] New jumpscares to make the experience even more intense.
[*] Added a new achievement: "NOSY".
[*] Added the ability to pause the game.
[*] Added new entries to the Main Menu.
[*] The Homunculus has a new look.
[*] Added several autosave points to make the experience less frustrating.
[/list]

IMPROVEMENTS
[list]
[*] Added a visual marker to deposited vinyl records.
[*] Improved the text of the poem in the Mirror Room.
[*] Enhanced the game's color grading.
[*] Improved cutscene animations.
[*] Improved character facial expressions.
[*] Mirrored the text of the poem in the Mirror Room.
[/list]

FIXES
[list]
[*] Fixed the skull's box collider in the Art Room and added a visual marker.
[*] Fixed the inverted "On/Off" switches.
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/c40dd639a66b3438ecea4e50ed5bfb3ab2e6374a.jpg[/img]

Can you find all the secrets we've added? Step back into the nightmare and discover what's hiding behind every shadow.

Thanks again for all your support, and as always, [b]don't forget to leave a review![/b] Your feedback is crucial for the future of [b]Scary Shadow Spot[/b] and the next chapters we have planned.

[b][h2]WARNING[/h2][/b]
If you have a game in progress, this is a major update, and it is not possible to continue with your current saves. Continuing your game will cause malfunctions.

You have two options:
1) Start the game from scratch and enjoy all the new features.
2)Go to the game properties on Steam and select the previous version of the game in the "Beta" tab. This will restore the old version, allowing you to continue with your saves.

[b]Doesn't Matter Games Studio[/b]

notes.title: New update for Scary Shadow Spot before the Steam Scream Festival!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I would like to take a moment to sincerely thank everyone who has already played [b]Scary Shadow Spot[/b]. Your support and your gaming experiences have been essential for the continuous improvement of the project.

[b]Reviews are incredibly important to me[/b] and are the best way to support the development of the next chapters. If you enjoyed the game or have any thoughts to share, a review on Steam can make a difference for the future of the series.

[h2]Thanks to feedback, we always improve![/h2] Watching your live streams on Twitch and reading your feedback has given me the opportunity to make some improvements to the game. This has allowed me to make Scary Shadow Spot even more engaging and terrifying.

[h2]New features coming for the Steam Scream Festival![/h2] With the upcoming [b]Steam Scream Festival 3[/b] on October 28, I want to take this opportunity to announce that I will be releasing a new update for the game in the days leading up to it! This update will include many new features and improvements that will surely surprise you. Here are just some of the new things you can expect:

[list]
[*] The ability to pause the game.
[*] New jumpscares to make the experience even more intense.
[*] A new achievement to unlock.
[*] Graphic improvements and new animations.
[*] And much more that I will reveal later...
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/3ebb1849efea9958af44a20dbb1eb985b440fb90.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, [b]thank you from the bottom of my heart for your wonderful support![/b] Don’t forget to leave a review to help me improve and develop new chapters for you.

[b]Doesn't Matter Games Studio[/b]
